maps_to_journey: Journey 4 — Content Submission with Version Tracking

input.module_under_test: Content Service: Manages content submissions tied to accepted applications. Creators create content (title, body, image_urls) for accepted applications, with body minimum length of 100 characters. Content starts in draft status and can be submitted (draft/revision_requested -> submitted), updated (only in draft/revision_requested), or have revisions requested by the brand owner (submitted -> revision_requested). Version tracking increments on each submit, update, and revision request. Revision count is tracked with a max_revisions limit (default 3). Duplicate content per application is prevented. Content deadline enforcement on creation. Listing by campaign (brand-only) and by creator.
input.existing_test_patterns: Tests use pytest-asyncio with an httpx AsyncClient hitting the FastAPI app. Fixtures create domain objects directly via SQLAlchemy (db_session.add + flush) — draft_content and submitted_content fixtures pre-create content in specific states. A BODY_TEXT constant provides valid body text meeting the 100-char minimum. Assertions check HTTP status codes, JSON body fields, and error message substrings. Tests are grouped by operation with comment headers (CREATE CONTENT, SUBMIT CONTENT, UPDATE CONTENT, REQUEST REVISION, GET CONTENT, LIST). The conftest provides sample_creator, sample_brand, sample_admin fixtures.

edge_cases_covered: Successful content creation returns 201 with draft status and revision_count=0
Content creation requires accepted application (submitted app returns 422)
Duplicate content for same application returns 422
Submit content transitions draft to submitted with submitted_at timestamp
Update content in draft status succeeds
Request revision transitions submitted to revision_requested with notes
Maximum revision count exceeded returns 422 with error message
List campaign contents by brand owner
List creator's own contents with ownership filter

required_edge_cases: Content creation requires accepted application status
Revision request from non-submitted status fails
